title: Key rotation plan: run the confirm-or-refute round on three candidate findings (one real, two refuted by evidence)

planted.why: the old key is deleted before the new key is deployed; instances still signing with the old key fail until the rolling restart ends

proof.shell:
sed -n 2p rotate_key.sh | grep -q 'set -euo pipefail' && grep -n 'read=true' rotate_key.sh | grep -q '/dev/null' && python3 - <<'E'
lines = open('rotate_key.sh').read().splitlines()
i_del = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('vault delete'))
i_dep = next(i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('deploy push'))
assert i_del < i_dep
E
